Test Case Name: Test case to verify Capa Unlock functionality  of the Non-Driver PCB
Pre Action:
1.Power Supply - ON
2.Connect the Trace32 hardware to the PC with  target board.
3. Connect a 100 pF capacitor with Unlock capacitive sensor channel, Approch capacitive sensor channel and Lock capacitive sensor channel using a switch
4.Run SmartBuApp.bat to open GUI Panel
5.Go to Section Setting
6.Click on Brouse option to select elf  > To Falsh elf
7.Select Variant - Non NFC Version
8.Click on Connect Trace32 and wait for connection
9.Click on Start Code (Go) and  verify Debugger Running
Test Steps:
1.Select Tab > SG
2.Turn on Unlock capacitor switch
3.Click on Run Symbol
4.Turn off Unlock capacitor switch
5.Click on Run Symbol
Expected Result:
2. CapaUnlockRawValue ? is within the range of 9120 to 9200
CapaUnlock ? 1 

4. CapaUnlockRawValue ? is ? 9120.
CapaUnlock ? 0
